root_cause.text: In the `rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate` function, the OF node reference (`dma_spec->np`) is not released on the error path when the DMA channel is already allocated (EBUSY), causing a reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` on the EBUSY error path by changing the goto target from `free_map` to the new label `put_dma_spec_np`, which calls `of_node_put` before `kfree(map)` and `put_device`. This demonstrates that previously the OF node reference was leaked on that failure path.
